summary: Iteration 116 — Skip policy Phase 1 verified backend-authoritative on shared backend; 11/11 pytest PASS (iter116.xml). Free=1/rolling 3600s and Premium=6/rolling 3600s enforced correctly with normalized skip_state shape (unlimited ALWAYS false, reset_in_sec math correct, events >3600s excluded). GET/PUT /api/admin/radio/skip-rules works and persists to radio_settings. 429 body includes {detail,tier,limit,used,remaining,reset_in_sec,window_sec,skip_state}+Retry-After header and upgrade_cta '...6 skips every hour' ONLY for free tier (premium 429 omits upgrade_cta as spec). A blocked skip writes a 'skip_limit_reached' event and does NOT increment completed 'skip' count. GET /api/billing/plans is clean (free.max_skips_per_hour=1, premium*=6, no -1/unlimited). Web /pricing (marketing, anon) also clean — '1 skip per hour' + '6 skips every hour' visible, no '∞'/'unlimited'. Web /radio Radio.js source and mobile app/(tabs)/radio.tsx source contain correct 'Skip · N left'/'Next skip MM:SS'/'{used}/{limit} SKIPS USED · 1H ROLLING' strings and disable the button when exhausted for both tiers. HOWEVER: the auth /pricing page (Pricing.js) STILL renders 'Unlimited skips · 2 VIP channels …' and the checklist 'Unlimited skips (1-hour rolling cap removed)' because /api/billing/config → services/stripe_setup.py:32,37 still ships those strings. Additional hard-coded copy leaks in frontend Pricing.js:145 ('Skip without limits.'), Pricing.js:149 ('Every skip on the house.'), and Pricing.js:172 shows an INVERTED X marker on FREE labeled 'Skip cap (6/hour)' (nonsensical — implies free has no 6/hour cap). Also Pricing.js:26 hard-codes FREE column bullet ' 6 skips per hour' — free tier is 1 skip/hour, not 6. These are all copy-sweep misses under this Phase 1 scope.

critical_code_review_comments: compliance.skip_state reset_in_sec math (line 207): idx = min(len(times)-1, max(0, used-limit)). When used==limit, idx=0 (oldest), reset when oldest exits — correct. When used>limit (should not happen but possible if policy shrunk mid-window), idx=used-limit points to the oldest event that still keeps user over cap — also correct.
server.py:4646 POST /radio/skip logs 'skip_limit_reached' inside try/except-swallow. If the analytics write fails silently, ops has no signal. Consider a WARNING log on the except.
